scope: Fresh groups relative to prior explicit target/day lists plus exact frozen R35H manifest; no tile reuse with G4, sidecar, drift candidates or within run. Synthetic injections on real archive backgrounds, not externally blinded or real source classification.

cousteau.regime: 95th percentile of column temporal medians, split at median calibration controls; two strata, minimum 64 controls each
cousteau.residual: Subtract 75% of positive persistent column median after row normalization; robust per-column scale shrinkage, floor 1, cap 4; clip residual upper 3; raw route retained separately. No independent reference scan, stationary signal may attenuate.

registration.reference: nearest paired OFF scan; physical channel grids checked before shift; no wrap; reject mismatched physical grids; candidate-local alignment uses no labels

turbo.scope: Original unchanged CPU Taylor kernel loaded by verified source, common preprocessing and custom symmetric shear range wrapper; not full turboSETI pipeline.

comparators.hyperseti: GPU not available in standard hosted CPU runner
comparators.bliss: full pipeline build and integration open
comparators.ma: random forest weights not shipped; full cadence shape and training required

fusion.rule: max of dimensionless branch margins (score - calibration control 95% threshold) / max(0.1, q95-q80) ; select corresponding path; separate joint threshold on calibration controls
fusion.protected: max over both raw and registered linear and Odonto margins, separately calibrate a single threshold; raw individual candidate retained as advisory output, not automatic veto
fusion.threshold: at most floor(0.05 * calibration controls) alerts for each mode, strict nextafter above descending order statistic

gate.rule: No deployment. Joint escalation must strictly improve overall and weak localization and reduce control alerts vs R28; zero paired lost localized, weak, shared, and positive alarms; production requires independent exam and speed proof.

shield.reference_feature: 95th percentile of positive temporal median over channels of normalized independent OFF patch; split at median on first 2 fit targets (control only); apply frozen split to all patches
shield.topa_statistic: Selected full hybrid path from exhaustive linear and Odonto search; second smallest of four four-row block means of registered path values; normalize using fit-control 95% threshold and q95-q80 scale; TOPA composite = min(full hybrid standardized margin, block support normalized margin). Calibrate the composite after path selection on separately acquired full actual control patches, not shuffled pixels; no independent p-value claim. Diagnostic tile-family maxima retain block dependence; tile-level threshold at 5% over null calibration tile maxima.
shield.thresholds: All decisions locked before reading evaluation data, component margins fit on first 2 targets; joint baseline threshold on next 4 targets (5%); pooled strict, KUSTO, TOPA, KUSTO+TOPA at 2.5% on same null targets; empirical order-statistic strict above cutoff. Strata lacking 128 controls or >=3 calibration targets use pooled conservative fallback. Tile-family max 5%, diagnostic not exact FAP.
shield.evaluation: Same 1024 test examples for all arms, 512 control/512 injected, paired deltas, weakest amplitudes <=1.25, per-target and per-source tile; 128 shared OFF leakage challenge. Record raw paths and scores; separate actual escalations from discovered/HOLD. No source classification. Any positive under threshold remains in retained raw records; no destructive veto. Report control alerts per observed exposure, cluster dependence, timing and added/lost counts.
shield.primary_gate: KUSTO+TOPA escalated localized >= baseline, escalated weak localized >= baseline, control alerts <= floor(baseline control alerts/2), baseline control count >0; no decrease in shared-signal challenge localized count; development gate only, no external independence nor deployment. If baseline zero controls, HOLD. Count parity alone not proof of equivalence; paired losses separately.
shield.known_signal_limitation: R30B shared-signal challenge only; BLC1/Voyager external reference replays remain separate R30F gate. Do not confuse synthetic injection recovery with confirmed radio source.

r35.fit: 2 fit targets for branch margins only, 2 disjoint null targets for all thresholds at 5%. No eval metrics used in tuning.
r35.weak: Amplitude <=1.25; report 0.75 class separately. Same 512 injections and 512 controls, paired loss counts, 128 shared reference stress. Per-target/day and source tile retain labels and outputs. No claim true astronomical FAP.
r35.juxtapose: Use original R18A j.GROUPS, j.score and j.witness, ordered groups calibrated only by fit controls+positives after linear threshold fixed on null. Rank deterministic by marginal hit probability/cost. Compare scalar exhaustive vs exact existential early exit on registered arrays; declare binary decision equivalence, counts, runtime; do not substitute first hit for best localization.
r35.gate: primary hybrid_plus_smooth strictly more localized and weak than Hybrid R28, controls no greater, shared localized no less. Report paired losses even when counts improve; any paired weak/shared loss HOLD for adoption. No claim full native pipeline or external independent custody.
r35.timing: Wall time per branch plus total preprocessing shared; RSS entire process, not isolated per-arm; full native benchmarks separately. Native Taylor kernel verified upstream, not entire turboSETI.

memory.policy: Only 1 G4 VERIFIED_RFI and 6 external replay references eligible; drift 4 candidate passports advisory only, no suppression. All query spectra unpersisted synthetic/real controls.

juxtapose.rule: Rank original eight groups by fit-only hits/cost; exact linear maximum using native ordered search, conservative row-max suffix upper bound and deterministic original tie ordering. Assert bit-exact scores and paths vs exhaustive straight for every evaluated array. Track pruned paths, full candidate count, runtime including compilation and preprocessing; no early-exit first hit as optimum.

r35h.odonto: Unmodified R28 registered curved path branch; preserve selected maximum.
r35h.raw: Retain independent raw smooth bank path and score separately. Rescue only baseline-negative candidates at thresholds fit on null controls; never override existing baseline localization.

policy.family: Require native grid compatibility (2%), shape match and physical frequency within 8.4 Hz and drift within .011 Hz/s; OFF support separately. No candidate-only suppression.
policy.fit: 2 fit groups, 2 null groups, 4 eval groups. Fit component margins first; calibrate baseline and raw threshold on null controls. Enumerate raw rescue and exact verified-reference advisory HOLD combinations with zero held positive alarms including shared and control count <= baseline. Select by weak, overall, control reductions; otherwise no-op. Freeze before exam.
policy.gate: Strict gains overall, weak, fewer controls, zero paired losses incl shared; no automatic veto, all records retained; speed examined separately.

r35h.release: Withhold external performance claims and distribution until independent validation, reproducibility, license/dependency and documented limitations. No outreach authorized now.

method.baseline: Original registered linear+ODONTO, exact original sum/tie; fit branch margins on component_fit and common 5% null cutoff
method.galaxy: Exact R36F1 compiled linear + unchanged ODONTO on two threads, original canonical tie. Same R28 score/path must replay for every example. Separate raw smooth bank; run HANNAH verified-reference advisory plus OFF corroboration; unconfirmed candidates never veto. Choose policy on null only with zero positive losses and <= baseline controls, freeze before eval. No-op admissible.
method.references: 7 verified measured reference occurrences, 4 measured unconfirmed review-only; frozen hashes from R35H; never persist injected test spectra.
method.native: Original pinned BLISS, fastDD and turboSETI adapters, identical float32 registered arrays as primary, plus raw normalized lane as diagnostic only if implemented; native methods independently calibrated on two same null groups. Exact adapter canaries. Native threshold not adjusted on eval.
method.measurement: Capture acquisition and patch construction, common norm/reference registration, calibration, compile/setup, detector+HANNAH+policy, result serialization, adapter input/read/validation and wall/process CPU, peak RSS. Shared preprocessing apportioned to each as common cost; report host model and separate per-process RSS. Compare same-host sequential subprocesses; no timing superiority claim if setup or scope differs. No actual remote two-runner claim.

r36f2.protected: 128 shared ON/OFF synthetic positives, separate from 512 ordinary injected positives and 512 controls. Actual measured compatible-grid useful signal and independently labelled real RFI still HOLD; no scientific or release PASS from injections alone.
r36f2.gate: Strictly improve localization/weak/control counts vs R28 with zero paired losses; compare each native at realized control rate, full cost including setup, not claim equal-FAP from nominal budget; external source-disjoint real controls and independent custody mandatory for release.
r36f2.release: HOLD independent real labels, protected measured signals, GPU, license and documentation, separately approved outreach.
